Read `README.md` and current rollout evidence first. Produce exactly one multi-wake target-policy candidate in `solver/`. Keep candidate-specific reasoning in `logs/optimize/wake_policy_notes.md`, and add or materially revise at least one evidence-backed reusable lesson in `guidance/control_experience.md` from the assigned parent, sampled solver results, and inherited logs. If no positive lesson survives the evidence, record a concrete negative result and what later workers should avoid or test. The candidate is incomplete until both files are updated. Work only inside this Phase 2 workspace.

This is the no-Bookshelf ablation: no cross-domain fish-control research shelf
is provided. Base controller proposals only on the task contract, current and
inherited guidance, sampled solver results, inherited optimizer logs, and
current rollout evidence. Do not search for or reconstruct the omitted shelf
from neighboring configurations or repository history.

I’m starting with the workspace contract and the wake-visual-signals skill, then I’ll inspect the current and inherited rollout evidence before touching the controller. I’ll keep the work confined to this Phase 2 workspace and will not look for the omitted research shelf.

The skill requires the visual diagnosis to precede any policy edit. I’m now mapping every sampled result and inherited log, then I’ll compare the best finite result with the most informative failure using their keyframe sheets and metrics.

The inherited large-bearing rolloff is now evaluated, and it is a strong negative result: it preserved finite joint/load behavior but collapsed the upstream leg to `-0.50L`, never got closer than `10.20L`, and exited sooner. I’m checking the sheets now to distinguish whether it simply weakened propulsion or changed the same upper-loop topology.

The sheets resolve the mechanism: the rolloff does not cure a late cross-axis pursuit. It changes the course before a useful upstream leg develops, then the fish repeats the same upper exit. I’ll record that negative lesson and choose a new bounded, body-frame intervention whose activation is tied to observed motion rather than bearing magnitude alone.

The durable guidance now records two closed negative branches: the `0.0425` derivative midpoint and the absolute-bearing rolloff. The candidate will restore the strongest finite anchor and add only a capped lateral-velocity damping term; this keeps the tested gait, guards, static bearing law, and `0.04` yaw-rate damping intact.

The candidate and both required evidence files are complete. I’m invoking the prescribed checks now: semantic guidance change, lightweight Julia policy contract, and editable-boundary validation. These checks do not run CFD.

The first check exposed a rendered-workspace metadata defect: `README.md` marks the same assigned parent twice, so the checker cannot identify exactly one parent. I’m repairing only that duplicate parent marker, then I’ll rerun the required sequence.

The semantic check passes. The Julia invocation is unavailable in this image (`julia` is not installed); I’m confirming that without the noisy login profile, then I’ll still run the deterministic schema audit and the required boundary check.

All available checks now pass: the guidance semantic check, editable-boundary check, and deterministic 17-field parameter-schema audit. The only unavailable check is the Julia runtime smoke because this workspace image has no `julia` executable; no CFD was run, as required. I’m doing a final file-scope and non-empty audit before handing off.

Produced exactly one candidate:

- [candidate_target_policy.jl](solver/cases/dogfish_2d_shape_policy/candidate_target_policy.jl:1) restores the strongest finite anchor and adds `0.35` body-frame lateral-velocity damping capped at `2°`.
- [wake_policy_notes.md](logs/optimize/wake_policy_notes.md:1) records the visual diagnosis and falsifiable hypothesis.
- [control_experience.md](guidance/control_experience.md:56) now records the negative midpoint and absolute-bearing-rolloff results.

Guidance, boundary, and 17-field schema checks pass. Julia runtime smoke was unavailable because Julia is not installed. No CFD was run. I also removed the duplicated assigned-parent marker in `README.md` so the mandated guidance check could resolve the parent.
